description: User unable to log in via SSO

ticket.summary: Cannot log in to dashboard — SSO error
ticket.description: I've been unable to log in to the dashboard since this morning. I get redirected to our SSO provider but then receive an 'invalid_grant' error when it tries to complete the login. I've tried clearing cookies and using incognito mode. Other team members can log in fine.

ticket.summary: Getting 429 Too Many Requests from REST API
ticket.description: Our integration has been hitting 429 errors since yesterday. We haven't changed our request volume. The API documentation says our plan allows 1000 requests/minute but we're being throttled at around 200/minute. We need this resolved urgently as it's blocking our data sync.

description: Data export timing out for large datasets

ticket.summary: CSV export fails with timeout for reports over 100k rows
ticket.description: When I try to export our monthly transaction report (approximately 150,000 rows) as CSV, the export starts but then fails after about 5 minutes with a gateway timeout. Smaller exports work fine. We need this data for our quarterly audit.

ticket.summary: Webhooks not being delivered to our endpoint
ticket.description: We configured webhooks for order.created and order.updated events but stopped receiving them 3 days ago. Our endpoint is https://api.ourapp.com/webhooks/orders and it's responding with 200 OK when we test it manually. The webhook logs in our dashboard show 'delivery_failed' status.

ticket.summary: 403 Forbidden when accessing shared team dashboard
ticket.description: I was recently added to the Analytics team but I'm getting 403 Forbidden when trying to access our shared dashboards. My team lead confirmed I should have access. My user ID is user-8472 and the dashboard ID is dash-analytics-main.
